title: Tile Survival latest design structural audit
status: read-only structural inspection; proposal awaiting review

definitions.missingAssetRef: An assetRef with a valid reference format whose exact file does not exist in this workspace assets directory. All assetRef properties recursively inspected, including image, skin texture, control tabSkin and buttonState image fields.
definitions.emptyImage: image object present but src/assetRef/asset all absent or empty. Framework background children whose parent has a custom texture are separated and not counted as missing artwork.
definitions.metadataImageText: The ordinary text label on an image element is not a placeholder when its image field has a valid source.
definitions.explicit3DPlaceholder: Text exactly 3D or 3D area in Korean. Explicit reserved scene/character/building region, separated from asset defects. No rendered 3D verification.
definitions.nativeControl: Element with control object, such as native input, toggle or tabs. Native text/image elements are not counted as missing controls.
definitions.buttonWithoutTransition: kind button without any outgoing transition from its own element ID. This is a structural link count, not proof of nonfunction: native control/menu/parent/inert semantics and runtime callbacks may differ.
definitions.enabledActionButtonWithoutTransition: Subset with effective action mode and enabled, excluding native control/menu/intentionalNoAction. Effective inputMode follows parts.mjs.
definitions.familyCoverage: First four family mappings use exact catalog-r63 screen IDs. Remaining mappings use current purpose TS prefix. Presence is not completeness or visual equivalence.

limits: Read-only current JSON and exact assetRef file existence inspection; no full original-video visual QA, no new browser checks, no runtime behavior or network 404 assertion.
The parent was authoring concurrently. Counts apply only to the recorded source revision and sha256.
catalog targetActual is historical r63. Its four-screen counts are not current; 31-family presence is mapped without overwriting the catalog.
No model, source, public report or STATUS changes performed. Only this scratch audit JSON is written.
Explicit 3D placeholders, unlinked actions and absence of native control are implementation-scope observations, not automatically visual defects.
